collection_gap: October 30 collection was paused intentionally at owner request and resumed November 24, 25 calendar days later. This was neither a quota stop nor a model failure.
comparison_limit: The baseline replies predate the resume. Unary selection finished before the pause; reasoning-before-verdict spans both periods; later conditions are collected after resumption. Codex CLI also changed to 0.160.1. Temporal service/client changes cannot be separated from harness effects in these comparisons. Requested model IDs and the Granite canonical slug/provider were retained; CLI IDs are not independently immutable weight pins.
pinned_transport_checks: One actual inference check per pinned model passed before new selection calls. An earlier local executable invocation failed on an unknown CLI feature before reaching a model; it is retained as a local startup failure, not model unavailability or an exam outcome.
quota_amendment: Nineteen positive/negative regression fixtures verify that quota markers are read from error channels, excluding successful response content. No prompt, reader, item, primary score or selection rule changed.
interrupted_calls: Three OpenRouter sends plus one Sol CLI send lacked replies at the pause. Each exact request was reconstructed from frozen inputs/settings and matched its existing SHA-256 key (paused_request_reconstruction.json). Two lost OpenRouter sends were retry index 2, one index 0. They remain unobserved sends; subsequent replies with the same keys are separate physical attempts.
spend: A $0.10 reserve per manually interrupted OpenRouter send adds $0.30 to the earlier $0.01622208 interruption reserve. Reservations are conservative accounting, not measured charges. CLI estimates omit unknown usage and are lower bounds when usage is missing.
budgets: All new harness requests begin with max_tokens=1600 on OpenRouter; length retries increase to 3200 and 6400. The inherited models.json setting mentioning 2600 solves describes notebook 33 metadata; no separate 2600-token solve call is made here. Codex has a 600-second process deadline and medium/low/high reasoning as specified by condition.
periods: collection_periods.json reports per-day spans including within-day pauses; exclude the 25-day gap when discussing collection operating wall time. Summed per-call seconds are parallel work, not wall time.
archive: If present, cache_archive_manifest.json documents lossless consolidation of working caches. Immutable from_33 archives stay unchanged; origin metadata identifies historical replies even if the working gzip also contains notebook36 replies.
probe_scope: Probe invocations are counted for cost/transport. Some resource probes intentionally requested an ok object, so generic pair-reader schema diagnostics on stage=probe are not exam-format failures. Exclude probe rows from task accuracy and unreadable totals.
capacity_stop: Persistent Sol exhausted HTTP429 was detected in the physical-attempt audit. This is a separate transport amendment from the requested error-channel-only quota guard. It withdraws no-answer provisional outcomes, preserves every raw record and all answer-based scores, and leaves recommendation and confirmation pending.
reference_comparison: Reference excludes instructions, so compare it with the matched 90-item baseline in paired_comparisons.csv, rather than the 120-item overall baseline.
